'''Imperial Strike Base 18''' was a strike base managed by the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] stationed on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] during the [[Great Galactic War]].

==History==
During the time of the [[Great Galactic War|Great War]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Braden]] tried to capture the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] Imperial Army Commander [[Dalborra]], but was stopped by orbital bombardment from Republic Commander [[Gin Lesl]] because the Republic signed a [[Treaty of Coruscant|peace treaty]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Braden was caught by Dalborra and later taken to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. Imperial Strike Base 18 also had two outposts away from the base with three large turret installations to warn about attack and to defend the base.

==Layout==
The Strike Base was in the middle of a forest on Dantooine and had three turret installations spaced out from each other in case of ground attack. The structure itself had about five levels.

==Appearances==
*''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant]]''
